attempts: Authorization header with single space but empty token ('Bearer '): implementation correctly extracts empty string as providedToken and rejects with 401 via providedToken === '' check
Malformed header with two spaces ('Bearer  s3cret'): implementation correctly skips parsing when rest.includes(' ') is true, leaving providedToken undefined, and rejects with 401

Case sensitivity of token vs scheme ('Bearer S3CRET' vs 's3cret'): implementation correctly applies case-insensitive scheme comparison via toLowerCase() while using strict equality (===) for token comparison
Authorization bypass via case-sensitive token comparison (attempt with uppercase token rejected by strict equality check)
Authorization bypass via extra whitespace (attempt with double-space header rejected by rest.includes(' ') check)
Authorization bypass by omitting Bearer scheme (attempt without space rejected by spaceIndex check)
Injection via ID parameter (attempt with path traversal patterns rejected by canonical digit regex)
Authorization precedence violation (attempt to leak existence via 404 on invalid auth rejected by auth-first order)
Attempt to bypass auth by omitting Authorization header: DELETE /items/1 with no auth header returns 401 (blocked)
Attempt to bypass auth with wrong token value: DELETE /items/1 with Bearer wrong-token returns 401 (blocked)
Attempt to bypass auth via token case variant: DELETE /items/1 with Bearer S3CRET (uppercase) when token is s3cret (lowercase) returns 401 (blocked)
